# 宇宙调整 / Cosmic Alteration

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:4927-4945; common/scripted_effects/cosmic_storms_scripted_effects.txt · DLC: Cosmic Storms · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

风暴消散时（storm_types 的 *_remove 效果），对风暴改动过矿点的有主星球有20%（磁暴25%）概率弹出 cstorms.8000“宇宙调整”（common/scripted_effects/cosmic_storms_scripted_effects.txt:411,520,629,738,847,956,1107）。

When a storm dissipates (the *_remove effects of storm_types) an owned planet whose deposits were altered has a 20% chance (25% for magnetic storms) of showing cstorms.8000 "Cosmic Alteration" (common/scripted_effects/cosmic_storms_scripted_effects.txt:411,520,629,738,847,956,1107).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知：风暴改变了星球上的矿点。

A one-window notice that the storm changed the planet's deposits.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项为确认，无后续。

The only option is acknowledgement; nothing follows.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

Cosmic Storms DLC。

Cosmic Storms DLC.
